decision: Use size-frequency for Chinese only; retain the original English v22 payload order. Reject all-size character interleaving.
evidence_scope: Native ranged complete NSP2 source; exact payload/geometry and rendered-pixel checks. This is not an emulator, physical calculator, display FPS, or split-container timing result.

identities.runtime_compatibility_note: The stage4 release candidate required later v22 split-source and boot-language acceptance corrections. The delivery manifest identifies that corrected runtime; these card samples measured the stage3 runtime.

build.driver_links: The same frozen stage4 driver was separately compiled against each frozen runtime header and static library.

fixtures.detail_first_sample: Includes the ordinary Detail command, pointer movement outside the description, and the complete rendered frame. It must not activate preparation.
fixtures.choice_preparation: 23 updates, 15 source calls and 178351 source bytes in Chinese, identical before/after. Retained as a separately reported cost; no font work moved here.
fixtures.cache_condition: Content and ResourceReader reopened per grid; OS page cache uncontrolled. Detail opens for the first time after the parent page warm window.

eng.method: size-frequency; localized codepoint frequency; existing 2-byte alignment

zhs.method: size-frequency; localized codepoint frequency; existing 2-byte alignment

timing.method: Three trials per condition, alternating order, one process fully exited before the next began. Parent and peer builds/tests/compression/emulator were paused for the complete approximately 44 second window. 180 advancing warm frames per scene. Host steady-clock CPU intervals only; OS file cache uncontrolled; no calculator timings.
timing.interpretation: Cold callback/byte improvements repeat exactly. Host CPU samples are mixed: some medians rise. No general CPU speedup, display responsiveness, or calculator performance percentage is claimed.

rejected_candidate.reason: Across-size interleaving reduced Chinese detail reads but increased cold grids in both languages.
